acceptance_criteria.statement: Envelope fields: schema rizzstack.preauth/2 and id, issuer, issued_at, expires_at, nonce, action_class, repos, bases, contracts, review, budget, conditions, max_uses, created_from; the JSON schema and the checker require exactly these (additionalProperties false), and the schema's action_class is an enum equal to ALLOWED_ACTION_CLASSES.
A malformed envelope (missing or extra field, duplicate key, non-object) refuses envelope_schema_invalid before any other check.

check(data, signature, allowed_signers=, trusted_fingerprints=, repo=, base_rev=, contract_sha256=, tier=, now=, facts=, is_ancestor=) returns ok with envelope_id, contract_sha256 and max_tier only for a correctly signed, in-date, unrevoked, listed, in-tier, in-budget first use.

The signature is verified with ssh-keygen -Y verify, identity = issuer, namespace rizzstack-preauth, over the exact bytes; tampered bytes, a foreign key, another namespace, a garbage signature or an issuer that is not the signing principal refuse envelope_bad_signature; with two principals the issuer binds to its own key only.

Trust root: every key line in allowed_signers must have a SHA256 fingerprint in the checker's trusted_fingerprints (supplied by the caller from the owner pin, not read from the file); an empty file, a key outside the pin, or an implementer-added key beside the owner key refuses envelope_signer_untrusted.
cert-authority lines, wildcard or negated or comma-separated principals, missing or wider namespaces, other key types and malformed lines refuse envelope_signers_invalid.

policy/allowed_signers is frozen: its sha256 equals ALLOWED_SIGNERS_SHA256 in the test file and its keys equal OWNER_FINGERPRINTS (empty in this slice); adding a key needs a new owner-approved contract.
now >= expires_at refuses envelope_expired; now < issued_at refuses envelope_not_yet_valid; expires_at more than 7 days after issued_at refuses envelope_ttl_exceeded even if signed.

Timestamps must be exact YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ and real dates, and expires_at must be after issued_at, else envelope_schema_invalid; a naive or missing clock refuses envelope_clock_invalid; an issuer that could be read as an option or pattern (leading -, *, ?, !, comma, space, non-string) refuses envelope_schema_invalid.
An envelope id in the measured revocation list refuses envelope_revoked, effective immediately.
Missing, null or mistyped revocation, consumed-use, nonce, attempt or bees-in-flight state refuses envelope_facts_unproven (fail closed).

action_class is an allowlist (merge_slice, refreeze_contract, vendor_sync, close_superseded_pr, dispatch_wave); anything else, including deploy, gate/lane, rulesets, force-push, preauth widening and case variants, refuses envelope_action_forbidden; the policy names every never-pre-authorizable class.

A repository not in repos refuses envelope_repo_mismatch; a repo missing from bases, or a base that does not descend from bases[repo], refuses envelope_base_mismatch; a contract listed only under another repo, or not listed, refuses envelope_contract_not_listed.
A slice tier above the contract's max_tier (T1 < T3) or an unknown tier refuses envelope_tier_exceeded.

oracle_paths covers tests, conftest, pytest/tox/setup.cfg/pyproject/setup.py/noxfile/.coveragerc, fixtures/data/helpers/__init__, test_*.py and *_test.py anywhere, sitecustomize/usercustomize/.pth/tests/plugins, requirements*, uv.lock, poetry.lock, Pipfile* and .github/workflows/*; it normalises ./, //, .. and backslashes first and refuses ../ or absolute paths.

A re-freeze is allowed only with identical oracle files at the old and new source_rev (product code may differ); changing, adding or removing any oracle file refuses envelope_oracle_changed; no measured oracle fact refuses envelope_oracle_unproven.

Budget: exact keys max_merges (int >= 1), max_bees (1..4), max_attempts_per_contract (int >= 1), max_uses a positive int (no bool/float), else envelope_schema_invalid; uses >= min(max_uses, max_merges), attempts >= max_attempts_per_contract, or dispatch_wave with bees_in_flight >= max_bees refuse envelope_budget_exhausted; uses of another envelope do not count.
A second use for the same contract refuses envelope_replayed; a nonce recorded for a different envelope id refuses envelope_nonce_reused.

Recorded at the process layer (subprocess.Popen and the os exec/spawn/system/fork family), check() starts exactly one process, argv ssh-keygen -Y verify; a missing ssh-keygen or one that hangs (bounded timeout) refuses envelope_verifier_unavailable.
Key custody: the module defines no sign/mint/generate name (AST and runtime names), never names -Y sign, holds no private key text; no tracked file contains private key material of any common format.
policy/preauth.md states signed approval and immediate revocation and that agents never create, widen or extend envelopes.
policy/preauth.md proposes P1-P5 with mechanical conditions, a ledger and a daily digest; P1 is the first numbered condition and covers frozen test blobs, conftest, pytest config and fixtures.

assumptions: ssh-keygen with -Y (OpenSSH >= 8.2) is present on the box and on GitHub-hosted runners; if it is missing or hangs the checker refuses envelope_verifier_unavailable.

Facts (revocations, consumed uses, nonces, attempts, bees in flight, oracle blob maps, ancestry) and trusted_fingerprints are supplied by the caller; this slice only decides from them, and missing facts refuse.
policy/allowed_signers is committed by RED with comments only and is read_only; adding the owner's public key is a separate owner-approved contract that updates the pin.
tests/test_preauth_policy.py is r3's file with one test re-cut (hash approval -> signed approval) and FIELDS extended (review added).
P4 (deploy) is proposed in policy/preauth.md but deploy is not in ALLOWED_ACTION_CLASSES (t1623u needs a typed yes per deploy); whether to ever pre-authorize deploys is the owner's decision.
A throwaway GREEN prototype (not committed) passed every test in the repo (415 passed, 3 skipped).
notes: Wiring is out of scope and is the separate named slice preauth-wiring: the gate/lane call check() with measured facts and the owner pin. Recommended to sequence it after gate-authority r2 (S1), because it touches the same vendored lease_tamper.py and merge_lane_v5.py in seven repos.
Until preauth-wiring lands, envelopes authorize nothing; every owner approval stays a typed line.

observable_behavior: check() returns ok only for a valid, trusted, in-date, unrevoked, allowlisted, listed, in-tier, in-budget first use

named refusals: envelope_schema_invalid, envelope_clock_invalid, envelope_signers_invalid, envelope_signer_untrusted, envelope_bad_signature, envelope_verifier_unavailable, envelope_expired, envelope_not_yet_valid, envelope_ttl_exceeded, envelope_facts_unproven, envelope_revoked, envelope_action_forbidden, envelope_repo_mismatch, envelope_base_mismatch, envelope_contract_not_listed, envelope_tier_exceeded, envelope_oracle_unproven, envelope_oracle_changed, envelope_nonce_reused, envelope_replayed, envelope_budget_exhausted
the module starts only ssh-keygen -Y verify and never signs
outcome.summary: The owner signs one bounded envelope with ssh-keygen -Y sign -n rizzstack-preauth on their own machine. policy/allowed_signers is a frozen, read-only trust root (hash-pinned by the tests; empty in this slice so every envelope refuses), and the checker additionally requires every key to match caller-supplied owner fingerprints, so an implementer cannot add a key. scripts/preauth.py (stdlib plus ssh-keygen) verifies and decides one use from measured facts, refusing with a named reason on any doubt, including missing state. This slice does not wire the checker into the gate or lane: that is the separate named slice preauth-wiring.
